hooks.text: Sunday night me writes the program. Tuesday morning me has to run it.
hooks.rationale: Opens inside the gap between planning and doing, which is the moment this idea is actually about — no argument needed before the viewer recognises it.

hooks.text: You didn't fall off. You built a week for someone with more free time than you have.
hooks.rationale: Takes the blame off the viewer and puts it on the plan, which is the reframe the rest of the reel depends on.

hooks.text: Consistency isn't discipline. It's a plan small enough that you can't talk yourself out of it.
hooks.rationale: Contradicts the discipline story head-on and lands the real mechanism in the same breath.
